text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Verxina received a fan letter.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, this sender is...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. The other day, during my independent training—

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much
for picking up my sheet music...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing major.
More importantly—you were practicing quite enthusiastically, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even though we were in the middle of training,
I couldn't help but be captivated listening to it.

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text:
"My playing really isn't... anything special.
I've always just played the 2nd part, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Second?

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...In my club, parts are divided by skill level.
The best player takes 1st with the solo,
while I support them in the 2nd part."

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I've always longed for the star 1st chair position.
But there's an amazing genius playing the same instrument,
so that girl always gets the solos...

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why this practice is completely pointless.
No matter how hard I try, I'll never beat her..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Are those words really from your heart, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Brass Band Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I felt it in your melody.
A burning, flame-like emotion deep within.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—"I absolutely don't want to lose."
Admitting that must be scary, isn't it?
Because it feels like you'll be consumed by a dark, smoldering flame.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that fire makes the blood boil,
and fills one's limbs with surging power."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Whether it consumes you or turns into strength is up to you.
However, if strength is what you desire—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You must never abandon it.
The resolve that 'next time, I will definitely win.'

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
""...Ever since then, I've watched
a lot of your races, Verxina-san.""

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"In every race, she was overflowing with the dignity and fierce spirit of someone who knows she is number one...
It gave me the courage to follow my own heart, too."

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text: "We have club auditions coming up soon for the next competition. Naturally, that genius girl is the top contender for first chair, but—"

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I won't settle for second best anymore!
I'm definitely going to play the solo, and I look forward to reporting that in my next letter!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: So they say. ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: You can't afford to lose either!
You can't afford to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall show her as well.
The brilliance of one who stands at the pinnacle—!
